name: Chinese Hamburger Casserole
description: A hearty, savory casserole featuring ground hamburger, rice, and vegetables, with an optional addition of bean sprouts for an authentic touch.

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown hamburger in a skillet; add the onions, celery, cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups.
Stir in the mushrooms, warm water, uncooked rice, soya sauce, pepper and salt.
Add bean sprouts if using for a more authentic taste.
Turn the ingredients into a casserole dish and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, stir the casserole and continue baking for about 15 minutes longer.
Sprinkle chow mein noodles over casserole and bake for 15 minutes more (total baking time is 1 hour).

keywords: Chinese casserole, hamburger casserole, rice casserole

_similar.name: Hamburg Noodle Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole made with ground beef, noodles, and a blend of creamy soups and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion, then add the mushrooms.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, soups, noodles, and Ragu. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to casserole dishes and top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake until the cheese is melted.

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Broccoli
_similar.description: A creamy chicken and broccoli pasta bake with Parmesan cheese and mushroom soup.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the small shells pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Add cooked broccoli, chopped chicken, cream of mushroom soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, and ground pepper to the cooked pasta.
Boil the mixture for 2 minutes to heat through and combine the sauce.
Serve hot with a cranberry salad.

_similar.keywords: chicken and broccoli, pasta bake, creamy chicken

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti sauce, homemade tomato sauce, Italian sauce
